title: Review fix (HIGH): activity dates are local dates and relative labels render after mount
interface: This is a review fix. The findings come from an adversarial review of commits b7f83ec..HEAD; the finding text is quoted in this interface. Pages are client components that are also server-rendered in UTC on Vercel, so anything that depends on the current date or the local time zone must not render differently on the server and in the browser (compute it after mount with the useSyncExternalStore mounted-flag pattern that app/dashboard/calendar/client.tsx uses, and render a neutral placeholder before). Postgres DATE columns arrive as 'YYYY-MM-DD'; new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') is UTC midnight and shows the previous day west of UTC, so parse them as local dates. Finding HIGH: components/dashboard/ActivityFeed.tsx:33 does new Date(activity.date || activity.created_at); activities.date is a DATE, so a user in America/New_York on Oct 1 sees 'Yesterday' in the browser while the UTC server rendered 'Today' -> wrong day and a React hydration error on /dashboard/overview. app/dashboard/activity/client.tsx:120 has the same parse. Fix, test-first in tests/local-date.test.ts (set process.env.TZ = 'America/New_York' inside the test file in beforeAll and restore it in afterAll, because Git Bash drops TZ= prefixes): new plain module lib/utils/local-date.ts exporting parseLocalDate(value: string | null | undefined): Date | null (a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string -> new Date(y, m - 1, d); any other string -> new Date(value); invalid or empty -> null) and relativeDayLabel(date: Date, today: Date): string returning 'Today', 'Yesterday', 'N days ago' (2-6 days), otherwise date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) (match the exact wording the Activity page uses today; read it first).
